verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an official `pd` CLI with a reference page covering deploying event sources (`pd deploy`), live local development with file-watching sync (`pd dev`), streaming emitted events to the terminal, and built-in help, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output), and evidence the CLI covers workflows beyond event sources/components.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run `pd` to see a list of all commands with basic usage info, or run `pd help <command>` to display help docs for a specific command.

pd dev will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes. When you save changes to your local file, your component will automatically be updated on Pipedream.
Deploy an event source from local or remote code. Running `pd deploy`, without any arguments, brings up an interactive menu asking you select a source.
Returns historical events sent to a source, and streams emitted events directly to the CLI.
